answer_2.quote: For a robust evaluation of attribute value extraction, we report several metrics. For a test product, we consider as true positive the case where the extracted values match at least one of the ground truth values (as some of the ground truth values may not exist in the text) and do not contain any wrong values. We compute Precision (Prec) as the number of "matched" products divided by the number of products for which the model extracts at least one attribute value; Recall (Rec) as the number of "matched" products divided by the number of products associated with attribute values; and F1 score as the harmony mean of Prec and Rec.
